questions.question: What repeated refrain frames Psalm 118?
options: Praise him in his mighty heavens
Bless the LORD, O my soul, within me
The LORD is my light and my song

questions.question: What stone imagery does Psalm 118 contain?
options: A cornerstone of pure gold set in the temple wall
A heavy millstone hung about the neck of the wicked
The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone
A stone of stumbling laid in the path of the proud
questions.answer: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone
